name: ORCA Lite Web remediation deep routing

definition.name: ORCA Lite Web remediation deep routing

nodes.prompt:
Dispatch exactly one fresh ChatGPT Web helper batch for two isolated ORCA Lite implementation tasks, then return the complete helper JSON. Do not edit repository files, create commits, force a browser driver, start a second helper, or close scopes. Invoke ONLY `/Users/indo/code/project/omo-bridge/target/release/delegate_to_chatgpt_web --batch-stdin --json` once, leaving browser-driver unset. The input must be JSON with workspace `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite` for each task:
1. Label `orca-lite-backend-t3-writer-lease`: Own ONLY src-tauri/src/worktree/manager.rs, model.rs, git.rs, src-tauri/src/ipc/worktree.rs, src-tauri/tests/worktree_safety.rs, e2e_agent_workflow.rs. Preserve frontend changes; no commit. Complete and test the pre-existing Phase 3 writer lease: canonical writer exclusivity, RAII release/reacquisition, active-writer delete reject, serialized check/remove, safe unmerged default delete versus explicit destructive delete, leading-dash validation. State exact unowned terminal binding blocker if one exists. Return changed paths, tests/exit codes, completion evidence.
2. Label `orca-lite-frontend-t4-ipc`: Own ONLY ui/src/App.tsx, components/WorkspaceHeader.tsx, components/WorktreeList.tsx, lib/tauri.ts, tauri.test.ts, ipcErrors.ts, ipcErrors.test.ts, lib/types.ts, types.ts. Preserve backend changes; no commit. Complete and test Phase 7.2: no direct component invoke, typed wrapper-only commands, camelCase matching Rust DTO, stable code-based structured errors, remove obsolete types only if unused, preserve terminal split semantics. Return changed paths, tests/exit codes, completion evidence.
Stop after helper JSON or its authoritative terminal/capacity/rate-limit failure.
